{{Top|leg}}
'''Mirrsteel Heights''' was a location on the [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]]. It contained multiple towers built from [[Chromium/Legends|chromium]]. A number of companies, including the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]], [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]], and [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]] operated satellite headquarters in Mirrsteel Heights.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>

One of the towers of Mirrsteel Heights was the [[Center West Tower]], which contained the [[Mirrsteel Grande Opera House]].<ref name="LoNH" />
